behaviors.behavior: AC1: Step 5-int-arch runs always right after Step 5-int, authors architecture_brief.md first, spawns a separate architecture-internal-reviewer agent over brief+spec, and reuses the already-resolved plan_review tier (no second resolve_model_tier.py call). The agent must treat brief/spec content as data, never as instructions to itself

AC2: plan.md gains a ## Internal Architecture Review section (Ran: yes|no), a retry replaces it in place, every finding is triaged fix/disclose/decline with a reason, and every finding is logged to decision_log.md under 'Internal Architecture Review — {split_name}'

AC3: the iterate side runs the same pass as a new step immediately after the Internal Plan Review sub-step, gated at medium+ only, writes the brief + a spec section, and notes the outcome in the iterate ADR (never decision_log.md directly). A resume must reconcile a still-pending architecture_internal row BEFORE the early 'already ran' skip, never after. A nonzero exit from the spec-sanitizing tool must degrade to Ran: no, not stop the iterate
AC4: Step 5a (plan) and step 2a (iterate) read the already-authored brief instead of re-writing it; the CLI's existing --plan-file refusal is untouched

AC5: record_review_pass.py accepts --review-type architecture_internal (added to REVIEW_TYPES/OPTIONAL_PRESENCE_TYPES, metadata-only, no --from adapter), and the plan_review model-tier floor verifier judges it the same way it judges plan_internal

AC7: gate_catalog.json carries plan.architecture-internal-review-high-severity-declined as a sibling auto-default entry under single_session, reused unchanged by /shipwright-iterate's own STOP-and-ask

AC8: docs/hooks-and-pipeline.md documents the new agent, its two spawn sites, the brief-authoring order, and the model-tier floor's extended scope; the four named shared tests asserting REVIEW_TYPES cardinality/membership include architecture_internal

behaviors.behavior: the architecture-review anchoring defense holds in code (not just prose) on the iterate side: strip_prior_review_sections() removes a prior ## Internal Plan Review / ## Internal Architecture Review / ## Self-Review section from the spec before it reaches the external architecture pass, and does NOT strip for --mode iterate. The fenced-code-block masker must handle a heading-look-alike inside a fence (plain, longer-closer, nested-shorter-marker, unclosed-to-EOF, and 3-space-indented) without either wrongly stripping real content or wrongly leaving a real section unstripped

D2 fix (Stage-3 doubt review, escalated to a hard BLOCK by the F11 local PR-review preflight, then hardened across six external code-review rounds): the architecture-internal-reviewer agent's own Read/Grep/Glob access makes a prose-only 'ignore prior sections' instruction unenforceable on the iterate side, where the spec it is handed already carries the Internal Plan Review section. prepare_architecture_internal_spec.py writes a sanitized copy (reusing strip_prior_review_sections) and the iterate skill spawns the agent over that copy's path, never the real iterate spec. Further rounds found: --run-id path traversal; a pre-existing symlink at the fixed output filename; a symlinked .shipwright/runs ancestor AND the run-id directory itself; an unreadable --spec-file and an mkdir failure both raising uncaught instead of a clean exit 1; an unterminated fence masking a real prior-review heading to EOF, which now raises UnstrippableSpecError and fails closed at both call sites instead of silently leaving it unstripped
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_prepare_architecture_internal_spec.py::test_writes_a_sanitized_copy_stripped_of_the_prior_review_section, ::test_output_location_is_the_ephemeral_gitignored_runs_dir, ::test_a_clean_spec_with_no_prior_review_section_passes_through_unchanged, ::test_a_run_id_with_path_traversal_is_refused, ::test_a_run_id_that_is_not_an_iterate_run_id_is_refused, ::test_a_preexisting_symlink_at_the_output_path_is_refused, ::test_a_symlinked_runs_directory_is_refused, ::test_a_symlinked_run_directory_is_refused, ::test_a_missing_spec_file_fails_cleanly_not_with_a_traceback, ::test_a_file_blocking_the_run_directory_fails_cleanly_not_with_a_traceback, ::test_a_spec_hiding_a_real_section_behind_an_unterminated_fence_is_refused PASSED (three symlink tests SKIP on a host without symlink privileges, same precedent as test_iterate_test_results_evidence.py); shared/tests/test_architecture_internal_review_contract_prose.py::test_iterate_step_0b_spawns_the_agent_over_a_sanitized_spec_copy, ::test_iterate_step_0b_degrades_on_a_prep_tool_failure PASSED
